blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React

items: You don't need a wrapper element for styling.
You're returning multiple elements from a component.
Adding a <div> would break your layout or CSS.

blocks.content: For JournalForm, using a <section className="card"> is better because it provides structure for styling. But knowing about fragments is still a bonus in my opinion, which is why I introduced it to you.
Next, you'll see a simple example of a fragment being used inside a component.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
